title: The Luminari
description: Justin's original aliens: beings of living light who communicate in color and remember in spectrum.

title: The Deep-Keepers of Europa
description: Justin's original aliens: the intelligent swimmers of Europa's ocean, who farm thermal vents.

title: The Chorus
description: Justin's original aliens: a hive-mind of small fliers whose thoughts are songs sung together.

title: The Stone-Singers
description: Justin's original aliens: silicon-based slow beings who sculpt mountains as their writing.

title: The Tide-Minds
description: Justin's original aliens: a distributed ocean intelligence that thinks with currents.

title: The Ember-Folk
description: Justin's original aliens: plasma beings living in a star's chromosphere, for whom planets are cold myths.

title: The Weavers
description: Justin's original aliens: spider-like engineers who build with gravity, spinning orbital webs.

title: The Quiet Ones
description: Justin's original aliens: the listeners of the galaxy, who have heard everything and answered nothing — yet.
